visualTexts.title: Primary 3 Timetable
visualTexts.html:
PRIMARY 3 KINDNESS — TIMETABLE

Recess is from 9.30 to 10.00 a.m. every day.

TimeMondayTuesdayWednesday
8.00 – 9.30EnglishMathematicsEnglish
10.00 – 11.00MathematicsScienceMathematics
11.00 – 12.00ScienceArtMother Tongue
12.00 – 1.00Physical EducationMother TongueMusic

Bring your recorder on the day you have Music. Bring your PE kit on the day you have Physical Education.

questions.tip: The line above the table gives the recess time.

questions.q: Which subject do the pupils have first on Tuesday?
questions.tip: Read down the Tuesday column to the first row.

questions.q: On which day do the pupils have Art?
Which subject is taught on all three days?
questions.tip: Check each subject against all three columns. Mathematics appears in every one.

questions.q: On which day must a pupil bring her recorder?
questions.tip: The box says to bring it on the Music day. Find Music in the table.

questions.q: How long is the first lesson of each day?
questions.tip: The first row runs from 8.00 to 9.30.

questions.q: A pupil has forgotten his PE kit. On which day will this be a problem?
questions.tip: Find Physical Education in the table, then read which column it is in.

questions.q: Which statement is true according to the timetable?
questions.tip: Check each one. Count how many times Mother Tongue appears.

The library is closed on Saturday and Sunday. Any book taken out on Friday must be returned by the following Thursday.

questions.q: How many books does each dot stand for?
questions.tip: The line above the chart tells you what one dot means.

questions.q: On which day were the most books borrowed?
questions.tip: Look for the longest row of dots.

questions.q: How many books were borrowed on Wednesday?
questions.tip: Count the dots in the Wednesday row, or read the number at the end of it.

questions.q: On which two days was the same number of books borrowed?
questions.tip: Look for two rows with the same number of dots.

questions.q: How many more books were borrowed on Friday than on Monday?
questions.tip: Take the Monday number away from the Friday number.

questions.q: How many books were borrowed altogether that week?
A pupil borrows a book on Friday. By which day must she return it?
questions.tip: The box at the bottom gives the rule for books taken out on Friday.

questions.q: Why does the chart show only five days?
options: Nobody borrowed books at the weekend
The library is closed at the weekend
The chart ran out of space
questions.tip: The box at the bottom explains why there is no Saturday or Sunday row.
